definition: Synthetic patient identity, inspired by MIMIC subject_id.
encoding_detail: Type, identity or context only; does not store an event.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE patients(subject_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, gender TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(gender IN ('F','M')))

definition: Distinct hospital stays per patient with actual admission/discharge milestones.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE admissions(hadm_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patients(subject_id), edregtime TEXT, admittime TEXT NOT NULL, discharge_authorized_at TEXT, dischtime TEXT, CHECK(edregtime IS NULL OR edregtime<=admittime), CHECK(dischtime IS NULL OR discharge_authorized_at<=dischtime))

definition: Optional additional information for the SAME patient identified by patients.subject_id, in the SAME identifier namespace. A matching subject_id denotes the same actual patient. No FK is declared; this identity relationship is explicitly documented. Authored split-storage extension.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE patient_profile(subject_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, profile_verified_at TEXT NOT NULL, preferred_language TEXT NOT NULL)

definition: Optional additional information for the SAME hospital stay identified by admissions.hadm_id. A matching hadm_id denotes the same actual admission. Only a subset of admissions has a signed summary. Authored split-storage extension.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE admission_detail(hadm_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), discharge_summary_signed_at TEXT NOT NULL, summary_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(summary_status='SIGNED'))

definition: Distinct laboratory order; several measurements may belong to one order.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE lab_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, hadm_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), specimen_received_at TEXT, results_verified_at TEXT)

definition: Distinct medication order; repeated doses belong to one order.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE medication_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, hadm_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), medication TEXT NOT NULL, dispensed_at TEXT, stopped_at TEXT)

definition: Distinct procedure order; repeated execution episodes belong to one order.
encoding_detail: Actual one-time milestones are separate timestamp columns on the business object. NULL means not occurred.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE procedure_order(order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, hadm_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES admissions(hadm_id), procedure_name TEXT NOT NULL, preparation_completed_at TEXT)

definition: Repeated order actions, inspired by provider order transaction semantics; not a copy of poe.
foreign_keys: procedure_order_id → procedure_order.order_id; medication_order_id → medication_order.order_id; lab_order_id → lab_order.order_id
encoding_detail: Each occurrence is a separate row; action/event_txt determines activity. Technical emar.storetime is excluded.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE order_history(history_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, lab_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES lab_order(order_id), medication_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES medication_order(order_id), procedure_order_id INTEGER REFERENCES procedure_order(order_id), action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('ENTERED','REVIEWED','CANCELLED')), occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK((lab_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(medication_order_id IS NOT NULL)+(procedure_order_id IS NOT NULL)=1))

definition: Measurement occurrences with separately charted and available-result times, inspired by MIMIC labevents.
encoding_detail: Each row preserves a repeated occurrence; multiple timestamp columns emit distinct activity types within that occurrence.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE labevents(labevent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES lab_order(order_id), itemid INTEGER NOT NULL, charttime TEXT NOT NULL, storetime TEXT NOT NULL, valuenum REAL, valueuom TEXT, CHECK(charttime<=storetime))

definition: Medication administration or omission occurrences, inspired by MIMIC emar.
encoding_detail: Each occurrence is a separate row; action/event_txt determines activity. Technical emar.storetime is excluded.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE emar(emar_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES medication_order(order_id), charttime TEXT NOT NULL, event_txt TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_txt IN ('Administered','Not Given')), storetime TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(charttime<=storetime))

definition: Procedure execution episodes with start/end times, inspired by MIMIC procedureevents.
encoding_detail: Each row preserves a repeated occurrence; multiple timestamp columns emit distinct activity types within that occurrence.
origin: MIMIC-inspired synthetic benchmark; all type/order structure adaptations are authored
sql_constraints: CREATE TABLE procedureevents(procedureevent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES procedure_order(order_id), starttime TEXT NOT NULL, endtime TEXT, storetime TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK(endtime IS NULL OR starttime<=endtime))
